subject: 📅 Change to an event you registered for - $event_name
body:
Dear $student_name,

An event you have registered for has been changed. The differences are listed below so you can see exactly what is different.

=== WHAT CHANGED ===
$change_list

=== THE EVENT AS IT STANDS NOW ===
Event: $event_name
Date and Time: $start_datetime
Ends: $end_datetime
Location: $location
Organiser: $organizer_name
Status: $status

Description:
$description

Updated On: $updated_at
Updated By: $updated_by

=== DO YOU NEED TO DO ANYTHING? ===
If the date, time or location changed, check the new details still work for you. Your place is still booked — you do not need to register again.

If you can no longer make it, please let us know so the place can go to someone on the waiting list.

=== CONTACT ===
Students' Union Events: studentunion@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567

Best regards,
Students' Union Events Team

$signature
